```{r}
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
library(rvest)
library(httr2)
library(purrr)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true

snap_years <- c(2015, 2017, 2019, 2021, 2022)

urls <- c(
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20150101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20170101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20190101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20210101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20220201012049/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/"
)

scrape_snapshot <- \(url, snap_year) {
  page <- request(url) |>
    req_timeout(60) |>
    req_retry(max_tries = 3) |>
    req_perform() |>
    resp_body_html()

  votes <- page |>
    html_elements("td.imdbRating strong") |>
    html_attr("title") |>
    str_remove("^.*based on ") |>
    parse_number()

  page |>
    html_element("table") |>
    html_table() |>
    select(rank_title = `Rank & Title`, rating = `IMDb Rating`) |>
    separate_wider_regex(
      rank_title,
      patterns = c(
        "^\\s*",
        rank = "\\d+",
        "\\.\\s+",
        title = ".*?",
        "\\s+\\(",
        year = "\\d{4}",
        "\\)\\s*$"
      )
    ) |>
    mutate(
      snap_year = snap_year,
      rank = as.integer(rank),
      year = as.integer(year),
      number = votes
    ) |>
    select(snap_year, rank, title, year, rating, number)
}

imdb_snapshots <- map2(urls, snap_years, scrape_snapshot) |>
  list_rbind()
```

```{r}
imdb_snapshots |>
  filter(snap_year %in% c(2015, 2022)) |>
  select(snap_year, title, year, rank) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = snap_year,
    values_from = rank,
    names_prefix = "rank_"
  ) |>
  drop_na(rank_2015, rank_2022) |>
  mutate(
    rank_change = rank_2015 - rank_2022,
    decade = paste0((year %/% 10) * 10, "s")
  ) |>
  summarize(
    avg_change = mean(rank_change),
    .by = decade
  ) |>
  mutate(direction = if_else(avg_change > 0, "Rose", "Fell")) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = avg_change, y = decade, fill = direction)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Rose" = "#2a9d8f", "Fell" = "#e76f51")) +
  labs(
    title = "Classic Films Slide While 1990s Films Hold Steady",
    subtitle = "Average rank change in the IMDb Top 250 from 2015 to 2022",
    x = "Average Rank Change (Positive = Rose)",
    y = "Release Decade",
    fill = "Direction",
    caption = "Source: IMDb Top 250 (Wayback Machine). n = 190 films in both 2015 and 2022."
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
